parent: Assurex Health, Inc. (independent in the FY2016 grant year)
notes: Myriad Genetics' FY2017 10-K says it completed the Assurex purchase in August 2016, after the June 30, 2016 fiscal year end, so Assurex was an independent Mason, Ohio lab at the grant. Form 5500 shows 241 plan participants in 2015 and JobsOhio counted 124 retained jobs.

The company website no longer resolves and the archived copies are script-only, so the size rests on Form 5500 (68 plan participants in 2023) and the JobsOhio record of a $400,000 Revitalization Grant for the single Athens plant. A September 2016 Athens Messenger story on the plant's reopening is the only news coverage found, and it does not list an owner.

Nordson's FY2018 10-K states 7,536 employees worldwide, incorporation in Ohio and principal offices at 28601 Clemens Road, Westlake, Ohio. The grantee Nordson Xaloy was Nordson's screws-and-barrels unit in 2018; Nordson sold Xaloy in 2020, which is why the 2023 Form 5500 sponsor is Xaloy LLC.

parent: Stewart-MacDonald Mfg. Co., Inc. (majority owned by Champlain Capital, a private equity fund, so the operating company is its own parent)
notes: Champlain Capital's portfolio page lists Stewart MacDonald, and StewMac's own site records Champlain Capital as its parent organization, a fund rather than an operating group, so the Athens company stays its own parent. Form 5500 participants went from 89 in 2019 to 139 in 2023, and the site gives a 1968 founding in Athens, Ohio 45701.

The 2022 10-K reports 19,920 average full-time equivalent colleagues and headquarters at 41 South High Street, Columbus, Ohio. The grantee, The Huntington National Bank, is the holding company's only bank subsidiary, and JobsOhio counted 4,677 retained jobs.

company: ExactCare Pharmacy LLC (Nautic Partners portfolio company)
parent: ExactCare Pharmacy LLC (majority owned by Nautic Partners, a private equity fund, so the operating company is its own parent)
notes: The August 2020 archived site gives the address as 8333 Rockside Road, Valley View, Ohio and calls the company a Northeast Ohio employer, with no parent company named; Nautic Partners is a fund, not an operating group. Size is a band, not a count: Form 5500 shows 356 plan participants in 2019 and JobsOhio counted 185 retained jobs. The Tabula Rasa combination that lifted the company past 2,000 employees closed in late 2023, after the grant year.

Weastec's own site says Toyodenso was founded in 1947 in Tokyo and employs in excess of 10,000 associates globally, and JobsOhio's release says Weastec employed 184 people at its Dublin and Hillsboro sites and operates as a subsidiary of Toyodenso. The Ohio plants do not make the parent Ohio-based.

Root's 2021 10-K reports 1,571 full-time employees at December 31, 2021 and corporate headquarters in Columbus, Ohio. A workforce reduction of about 20 percent followed in January 2022, after the grant year, and JobsOhio counted 551 retained jobs.

The company site gives its address as 385 Pilch Road, Troutman, North Carolina and describes a group of over 5,600 employees and 620 grower farms; it was already above 3,000 at the time of the grant. JobsOhio counted 346 retained jobs at the Winesburg plant, which is one site in a multi-state group.

The FY2023 10-K says the company had 104 team members at December 31, 2023 and gives its principal offices as 233 Ayer Road, Harvard, Massachusetts. The grantee AquaBounty Farms Ohio LLC was the project subsidiary for the Pioneer, Ohio farm, and JobsOhio recorded zero retained jobs.

Masco's 2023 10-K says it employed approximately 18,000 people at December 31, 2023, lists BEHR among its brands and gives principal offices at 17450 College Parkway, Livonia, Michigan. The grantee Behr Process Corporation is the paint subsidiary, and the grant supported a new plant in Heath, Ohio.

The January 9, 2023 JobsOhio release describes Bullen as a privately held, family-owned business founded in 1971 and based in Eaton, Ohio, receiving up to $1 million from an R&D Center Grant. Form 5500 shows 169 plan participants in 2023 and JobsOhio counted 120 retained jobs.

parent: Forge Biologics, Inc. (independent in the FY2023 grant year; Ajinomoto Co., Inc. of Japan closed its purchase in late December 2023)
notes: Ajinomoto announced the $620 million purchase on November 13, 2023 and the sale closed in late December 2023, both after the June 30, 2023 fiscal year end, so Forge was a venture-backed Ohio company at the grant. Form 5500 shows 298 plan participants in 2023, and news coverage places the company in Grove City and Columbus.

LG Chem's own company page gives headquarters at the LG Twin Towers in Yeongdeungpo-gu, Seoul, a 1947 founding, and 17,389 employees, 12,943 of them in Korea. The grantee LG Chem America, Inc. is the US arm in Atlanta, whose Form 5500 shows 199 participants in 2023, far short of the parent group.

JBPCO's own careers page says the privately held company was founded in 1985, is headquartered in Houston, Texas, and is forecasting $2.3 billion in annual revenue and 9,000 team members across nine operating subsidiaries, Morgan Truck Body among them. Form 5500 shows 3,725 participants for the Morgan plan in 2015, and 2026 trade coverage still lists Morgan as a JBPCO unit.
